working_directory.description: Absolute path to the Go project root. All cartographer output files are written here (go-index.json, etc.).

review_session_id.description: UUID identifying the current security review session. Propagated to all specialist agent inputs and to synthesis.

code_ref.description: Git reference (branch, tag, or commit SHA) of the code being reviewed. Used for traceability.

code_ref_dirty.description: True if the working tree has uncommitted changes at review time. Propagated to all downstream verdicts.
